messages:
sara-sales: Heads up team — Argenta POC blocked pending security signoff and committed pricing. CISO wants BYO-KMS path + attestation before executive approval. They also need a pricing floor for sustained >1k qps. Can we triage and land an ask list for the exec bridge?
alan-se: Got it. Do we have the questionnaire PDF? I can start mapping answers.
sara-sales: Uploaded: https://acme-share/argenta-sec-q.pdf. Key asks: BYO-KMS, audit/retention, egress residency, and a 99.9% p99 latency SLA under their workload.
eva-eng: Their test workload: ~1200 concurrent streams, avg seq len 512. We'll need to pin model variant and batching strategy to hit p99.
mike-ops: For BYO-KMS we'll require customer IAM sain + network peering details. Also need to know whether they want Private (VPC) or Hosted with IP allowlist.
natasha-ciso: @sara-sales paste the specific KMS questions here. We usually provide our KMS integration matrix, but BYO raises attestation and separation-of-duties requests.
sara-sales: Pasting excerpt:
```
Q: Do you support customer-managed keys (BYO-KMS)? Describe lifecycle, rotation, and controls.
Q: Are keys ever accessible to vendor staff? Provide attestation.
Q: Encryption in transit and at rest? Certificates and attestation.
Q: Audit log storage and retention options.
```
alan-se: Draft answer: Yes for BYO-KMS on Private and Dedicated; keys remain in customer KMS, rotation managed by customer; access via constrained service principal; no plaintext key material stored on hosts. Audit logs can be forwarded to customer's log sink. I'll formalize.
natasha-ciso: Argenta also asks for HSM attestation and proof that crypto keys are excluded from our control plane. Need Legal + Infra artifacts.
liz-legal: I can draft an attestation addendum. Need a short technical artifact from infra describing KMS proxying and where keys live. @eva-eng / @mike-ops can you supply a diagram + config snippet?
eva-eng: Will attach a minimal diagram. Sample config snippet below:
```yaml
redwood_private: true
vpc_peering: true
kms_endpoint: "kms.us-east-1.argenta.example"
allowed_ip_blocks: ["10.32.0.0/16"]
```
alan-se: Note on fallback: ops wants a configurable feature-flagged fallback to a verified hosted key variant if the external KMS is unreachable >30s, with telemetry and alerting. Product signoff needed before we commit.
sara-sales: Finance — can you sketch discount tiers for committed spend and a path to lower per-token rates if sustained >1k qps? @trevor-fin
trevor-fin: Ballpark: for a 12-month committed volume we can offer 20% off list at baseline, with additional tiered rebates if sustained usage >1k qps for 30-day window. I'll prepare a sample table for the bridge.
deploy-bot: Exec bridge created: #exec-argenta-5pm-bridge scheduled 2026-05-14 17:00 UTC.
mike-ops: Ops can support the throughput on a Dedicated reserved pool. Will need exact model/instance types to size. Also will create runbook entries for BYO-KMS failover.
liz-legal: Adding attestation DRAFT to drive. Need infra snippet + exact SLA language (latency SLO vs contractual SLA).
natasha-ciso: We should avoid promising 99.9% p99 across hosted variants. Recommend: 99.9% p99 on Dedicated with pinned config; hosted is best-effort fallback. Also Argenta asked for configurable audit log retention up to 7 years — confirm Private supports pushing to customer storage with that retention.
eva-eng: We can forward logs to customer GCS/S3 with arbitrary retention; note the operational cost.
sara-sales: Action list for the exec bridge: 
1) Alan — finalize security questionnaire answers and fallback wording (EOD).
2) Eva/Mike — infra diagram + config + runbook snippet (EOD).
3) Liz — attestation addendum draft (tomorrow AM).
4) Trevor/Finance — pricing tiers & committed discount table (before bridge).
5) Natasha — confirm attestation checklist items we need from infra/legal.
6) Sara — prep exec deck and customer Q&A.
alan-se: I will not promise auto-fallback without a feature flag. Ops needs toggle + metrics (kms.failover_count).
mike-ops: Adding flag + metrics to PR. Failover procedure: 1) detect KMS timeout; 2) trigger controlled failover to hosted key variant if flagged; 3) raise incident and escalate.
liz-legal: For the addendum, I need exact wording on "no vendor access to keys" vs "technical access per emergency process". Please advise.
natasha-ciso: We can offer: vendor staff have no routine access; emergency access requires documented, auditable workflow and customer approval. That should be acceptable.
sara-sales: Thanks all. I'll consolidate materials into the exec deck. If we clear these items before the bridge we should unlock the deal. :thumbsup: 
alan-se: FYI I'll include a snippet about model pinning: we suggest Llama3-8B-quant with pinned instances to meet p99. Need product signoff.
eva-eng: Also flag quantization impacts on cost/latency — include benchmark numbers in the drive.
trevor-fin: Sending a sample pricing matrix in a few hours.
sara-sales: Great — I will post a follow-up in this thread with links to artifacts. Closing for now until items come in. :pray:
